name: Inaba
source:
A caretaker who supports you behind the scenes with a modest personality.
He is quiet but very kind, and he is reliable and helpful when in trouble.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/inaba.html]official website[/url]]
